survey: A refractor telescope on a tripod, standing on grey lunar ground. The cream tube is angled up to the right. The wide end holds a blue objective lens inside a larger dew-shield section and points at the sky. The narrow lower end steps down past a gold ring into a grey eyepiece, which faces the viewer at the back. Near the tube's balance point it sits in a grey cradle with a strap over the top. The cradle hangs between yoke plates, and a visible pivot bolt on the near plate lets the tube tilt. The yoke is bolted to a flat grey base plate. That plate sits on a round wooden tripod head. Three wooden legs fan out from under the head, one front-left, one right and one back-left. Each leg ends in a grey rubber foot that touches the ground and casts a matching shadow. Parts are in the right order and the right number: one tube, one eyepiece, one objective, one mount, three legs.
